name: Tizanidine
effects: Central alpha-2 agonist — reduces muscle hypertonicity via spinal interneurons
Significant sedation — often compared to a short-acting clonidine
Short duration; frequently used at night

halfLifeEvidence.quote: Its elimination half-life is approximately 2.5 hours.

mechanismOfAction.summary: Centrally acting alpha-2 adrenergic receptor agonist that reduces spasticity by inhibiting excitatory neurotransmitter release and enhancing presynaptic inhibition of motor neurons; may also potentiate the inhibitory neurotransmitter glycine.
mechanismOfAction.description: Short-acting central alpha-2 agonist, structurally a short-duration clonidine analogue. Extensively metabolised by hepatic CYP1A2 to inactive metabolites, so CYP1A2 inhibitors (e.g. fluvoxamine, ciprofloxacin) markedly raise tizanidine exposure and are contraindicated.
